channel.title: Farmer's Weekly SA - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Farmer's Weekly SA (farmersweekly.co.za)

item.title: FMD spreads across Eswatini, livestock sales suspended
item.description: The foot-and-mouth disease outbreak in Eswatini, first reported in May 2025, has spread extensively across the country, affecting cattle and pigs, with only one region remaining virus-free.

item.title: Boer goats: Resilient animals thriving even on hostile terrain
item.description: Giel Swiegers’s Boer goats aren’t the farm’s main income, but by grazing once-unused slopes, they play a vital role in keeping his farm, Witrivier, resilient and productive.

item.title: FMD crisis hits meat supply, threatens exports, drives prices up
item.description: Foot-and-mouth disease is destabilising South Africa’s meat supply chain, shutting down export markets, forcing the destruction of usable product, raising consumer prices, and threatening the beef industry with losses over R13 billion, while some dairy producers might be pushed out of production.

item.title: Weaner to grower: piggery turns waste into profit
item.description: Disease outbreaks, high maintenance costs and a fluctuating market remain constant risks for piggeries. As a result, farmers may experience losses and production delays. Jan Streicher, manager of the Riversdale Piggery, spoke to Henning Naudé about maintaining profitability through strict biosecurity measures and an efficient feed programme that capitalises on a waste product.

item.title: Keep cash flow healthy to HELP your farming enterprise thrive
item.description: A farm is purchased with capital, but cash flow keeps it running. From maintenance to insurance, the cost of ownership is often higher than new buyers expect. Andreas Greeff, managing director of Vleissentraal Eiendomme, shares advice for sustainable farm management.

item.title: Purpose-built vehicle solutions for your business
item.description: Custom single-cab conversions offer practical solutions for safe storage and transport across a variety of industries and businesses. Toyota-engineered alterations are now available through Hilux Custom Builds to ensure uncompromising performance.

item.title: UD Trucks targets lifetime profitability in volatile logistics market
item.description: UD Trucks Southern Africa is positioning itself as a long-term strategic partner to fleet operators navigating an increasingly complex and cost-pressured logistics environment, says Managing Director Filip Van den Heede.

item.title: Research-led talks to drive SA’s red meat sector decision-making
item.description: As South Africa’s red meat industry faces mounting pressure from animal disease risks, climate volatility and shifting market requirements, role players are increasingly turning to research-led platforms to support better decision-making across the value chain.

item.title: Cabinet memo drafted on FMD disaster declaration
item.description: The Department of Agriculture has confirmed that the Cabinet memorandum seeking a national state of disaster declaration over South Africa’s ongoing foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) outbreak has been drafted following a high-level meeting on 30 January.

item.title: Recycling pilot project aims to cut waste at Kruger Park
item.description: A recycling pilot project at Kruger National Park is successfully diverting significant volumes of waste from landfills and into South Africa’s circular economy, with lessons that could extend far beyond the park’s boundaries and into agricultural and rural settings.
